blocks.en: The Circumstantial Clause
Definition of الحال (al-Haal):

It is an expression that details the {{term|condition or state}} of a ‘فاعل’ (Doer), ‘مفعول به’ (Object), a ‘مبتدا’ (subject) or a ‘مجرور’ (Genitive case noun, often preceded by a preposition or in a possessive construction, a ‘مضاف إليه’).
The ‘الحال’ is always ‘{{ruling|منصوب}}’ and ‘{{ruling|نكرة}}’ (indefinite).
The one whose condition is being detailed is called ‘{{term|ذو الحال}}’ (Possessor of state)
Here are 2 examples, one where the ‘ذو الحال’ is a ‘{{label|فاعل}}’ and one where it’s a ‘{{label|مفعول به}}’.

blocks.caption: تركيب مثالين: جاء زيدٌ راكبًا، ونَصرتُ زيدًا مشدودًا، جملة فعلية خبرية
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb diagrams of examples 1 and 2, each labelled as a جملة فعلية خبرية

blocks.en: Zaid came whilst riding.
I helped Zaid whilst he was tied up.
Here is a an example where the ‘ذو الحال’ is a ‘{{label|مبتدا}}’.

blocks.caption: تركيبان للجملة نفسها زيدٌ جالسًا نائمٌ (3a و3b)، جملة اسمية خبرية، وفي 3b قوس يشير إلى الضمير هو في نائمٌ
blocks.caption_en: Two tarkeeb diagrams of the same sentence (3a and 3b), each a جملة اسمية خبرية; in 3b an arc points to the hidden هو inside نائمٌ

blocks.en: Zaid was sleeping whilst sitting.
Zaid was sleeping whilst sitting.
In 3a, the ‘ذو الحال’ is the ‘{{label|مبتدا}}’ ‘زيد’ and the ‘حال’ is ‘جالسا’ which is immediately after the ‘ذو الحال’. ‘نائم’ is neither ‘حال’ or ‘ذو الحال’ and nor is it ‘منصوب’.

In 3b, A different approach to sentence analysis for the identical sentence has been employed. Here, the ‘ذو الحال’ is the ‘{{label|فاعل}}’ ‘هو’ which is the ‘{{term|ضمير مرفوع متصل}}’ inside of ‘نائم’ the ‘{{label|اسم الفاعل}}’ and ‘جالسا’ is the ‘حال’. The ‘حال’ has preceded the ‘ذو الحال’. It is {{ruling|permissible}} for the ‘ذو الحال’ to precede the ‘حال’.
Here are a few examples where the ‘ذو الحال’ is a ‘{{label|مجرور}}’.

blocks.caption: تركيب مثالين: مَرَرْتُ بِزَيْدٍ ضَاحِكًا (جملة فعلية خبرية، مع خط منقط يصل الجار والمجرور بالمتعلق) وهذا مَشيُ زيدٍ مَجْرُوْحًا (جملة اسمية خبرية)
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb diagrams of 4a (a جملة فعلية خبرية, with a dotted loop joining the jaar-majroor to its متعلق) and 4b (a جملة اسمية خبرية)

blocks.en: I passed Zaid whilst (he was) laughing.
This is Zaid’s walk whilst (he is) injured.

In 4a, the ‘ذو الحال’ is the ‘{{label|مجرور}}’ ‘زيد’ which is preceded by a ‘{{label|جار}}’, a preposition. ‘ضاحكا’ is the ‘حال’ which is immediately after the ‘ذو الحال’. The ‘حال’ and the ‘ذو الحال’ are combined and labelled ‘مجرور’.

In 4b, the ‘ذو الحال’ is the ‘{{label|مضاف إليه}}’ ‘زيد’ and ‘مجروحا’ is the ‘حال’. The ‘حال’ and the ‘ذو الحال’ are combined and labelled ‘مضاف إليه’. There are some specific rules for this scenario, i.e. when the ‘ذو الحال’ is a ‘مضاف إليه’, which we will return to very soon Insha’Allah.
As we’ve just seen, the ‘ذو الحال’ can be:
As for the ‘حال’, it can come in the form of:
The ‘ذو الحال’ or the ‘حال’ will {{ruling|not manifest in any other way}}.
The derived noun

If the ‘الحال’ is an ‘اسم’, then it will either be a ‘{{term|مشتق}}’, a ‘{{term|مصدر}}’ or a ‘{{term|جامد}}’. The term ‘مشتق’ includes all 5 ‘مشتقات’: ‘{{term|اسم الفاعل}}’, ‘{{term|اسم المفعول}}’, ‘{{term|الصفة المشبهة}}’, ‘{{term|اسم المبالغة}}’ and ‘{{term|اسم التفضيل}}’.

blocks.caption: تركيب مثالين: أَكَلْتُ الطَّعَامَ حَارًّا وصلَّى المسلمُونَ قَائِمِيْن، جملة فعلية خبرية
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb diagrams of 5a and 5b, each a جملة فعلية خبرية

blocks.en: I ate the food whilst (it was) hot.
The Muslims prayed whilst standing.

{{condition|When the ‘الحال’ is a ‘مشتق’}}, it {{ruling|will correspond with the ‘ذو الحال’ in number and gender}}. The ‘مشتق’ form is the {{ruling|primary form}} for ‘الحال’. All other forms of ‘الحال’ are related to the ‘مشتق’.
The masdar noun
The term ‘مصدر’ includes all types of ‘مصدر’. Whether ‘{{term|مجرد}}’ or ‘{{term|مزيد فيه}}’, they’re all included.

blocks.caption: تركيب مثالين: فتحْتُ البَابَ صَرًّا وصلَّى المسلمُونَ قِيَامًا، جملة فعلية خبرية
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb diagrams of 6a and 6b, each a جملة فعلية خبرية

blocks.en: I opened the door whilst creaking.
The Muslims prayed whilst standing.

{{condition|When the ‘الحال’ is a ‘مصدر’}}, it {{ruling|will NOT correspond with the ‘ذو الحال’ in number or gender}}. ‘مصدر’ does not have a particular gender and nor does it have a single, dual or plural form. Therefore, ‘مصدر’ can be used, with the same form, in any context and it will express the ‘{{ruling|مشتق}}’ meaning. In 6a, ‘صَرًّا’ is in the meaning of ‘صارًّا’ and in 6b, ‘قيامًا’ is in the meaning of ‘قائمين’.
The non-derived noun
The term ‘{{term|جامد}}’ includes names and spontaneous nouns which are {{ruling|not derived}}. There are many ways the ‘جامد’ noun can be ‘الحال’. I shall elaborate on a few.

items: When the ‘جامد’ is used for {{condition|resemblance}}. The ‘جامد’ will be interpreted into a ‘{{ruling|مشتق}}’

blocks.caption: تركيب مثالين: تَصَدَقّْتُ المَالَ حَاتِمًا وفَرَّ زَيْدٌ أَرْنَبًا، جملة فعلية خبرية
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb diagrams of 7a and 7b, each a جملة فعلية خبرية

blocks.en: I donated wealth whilst I was (generous like) Hatim
Zaid ran whilst he was (a coward like) a rabbit.

{{condition|When the ‘الحال’ is a ‘جامد’ is a proper noun a name}}, it {{ruling|will NOT correspond with the ‘ذو الحال’ in number or gender}}. Despite the ‘جامد’ name having gender qualities and number forms, they’re not considered here. This is because it is not the ‘جامد’ name that is intended, rather the {{ruling|interpretation}} of the ‘جامد’ is intended. In 7a, ‘حَاتِمًا’ is interpreted as ‘جَوّادًا’ ‘{{label|اسم المبالغة}}’ and in 7b, ‘أرنبًا’ is interpreted as ‘جَبَانَ’ ‘{{label|الصفة المشبهة}}’.
The non-derived noun

items: When the ‘جامد’ is used in the meaning of {{condition|order, arrangement, sequence}}. Here, the ‘جامد’ will also be interpreted into a ‘{{ruling|مشتق}}’.

blocks.caption: تركيب مثالين: أَكَلْتُ الطَّعَامَ لُقمَةً لُقْمَةً ويَدْخُلُ الطُّلَّابُ رَجُلًا رَجُلًا، جملة فعلية خبرية
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb diagrams of 8a and 8b, each a جملة فعلية خبرية

blocks.en: I ate the food morsal by morsal.
The students are entering one by one.

Here, the ‘جامد’ {{ruling|will not correspond with the ‘ذو الحال’ in number or gender}}. This is because it is not the ‘جامد’ that is intended, rather, the {{ruling|interpretation}} of the ‘جامد’ is intended. In 8a, ‘لُقمَةً لُقْمَةً’ is interpreted as ‘مُرَتَّبًا’ ‘{{label|اسم المفعول}}’ and in 8b, ‘رَجُلًا رَجُلًا’ is interpreted as ‘مُرَتَّبِيْنَ’ ‘{{label|اسم المفعول}}’.
Al-haal: ism jaamid
3. When the 'جامد' is used in the meaning of {{condition|mutual participation in engagement}}. Here, the 'جامد' will also be {{ruling|interpreted into a 'مشتق'}}.

blocks.caption: تركيب: أعطيتُ زَيدًا يَدًا بِيَدٍ (9a) و لَقِيْتُ زَيدًا وَجْهًا لِوَجْهٍ (9b)، مع ثَابِتَةً / ثَابِتًا مقدّرا متعلَّقا للجار والمجرور
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb trees for 9a and 9b, with the implied ثَابِتَةً / ثَابِتًا written small as what the jaar-majroor attaches to

blocks.en: I gave (it) to Zaid (whilst) hand in hand.
I met/confronted Zaid (whilst) face to face.

Here as well, the 'جامد' will {{ruling|not correspond}} due to the interpretation of the 'جامد' being intended. In 9a, 'يدًا بِيدٍ' is interpreted as 'مُتَقَابِضَيْنِ' '{{term|اسم الفاعل}}' and in 9b, 'وجهًا لِوجهٍ' is interpreted as 'مُتَقَابِلَيْنِ' 'اسم الفاعل'.
Al-haal: ism jaamid
4. When the 'جامد' is used in its {{condition|original meaning and is not interpreted into a 'مشتق'}}. In this scenario, the 'جامد' {{ruling|must have a 'نعت'}}.

blocks.caption: تركيب: أَنْزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَربِيًّا (10a) و يَخْرُجُ زَيْدٌ رَجلًا كَرِيمًا (10b)
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb trees for 10a and 10b

blocks.en: We revealed it (whilst) an Arabic Qur'an.
Zaid is exiting (whilst) a noble man.

Here, the 'جامد' is {{ruling|corresponding with the 'ذو الحال'}} to maintain a valid expression. The meaning of the 'جامد' is intended here. There is {{ruling|no interpretation}} of the 'جامد' into a 'مشتق' here.
Al-haal: ism jaamid
5. When the 'جامد' is considered to be {{condition|a part of the genus of the 'ذو الحال' or vice versa}}. Here as well, the 'جامد' will {{ruling|not be interpreted}} into a 'مشتق'.

blocks.caption: تركيب: إشْتَرَيْتُ الفِضّةَ خَاتِمًا (11a) و إشْتَرَيْتُ الخَاتِمَ فِضَّةً (11b)
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb trees for 11a and 11b

blocks.en: I purchased silver in the state of a ring.
I purchased a ring in a silver state.
Here, the 'جامد' will {{ruling|not correspond}} with the 'ذو الحال'. The 'جامد' is not interpreted into a 'مشتق' here.
Al-haal: shibh al-jumlah
The term '{{term|شبه الجملة}}' includes '{{term|جار مجرور}}' and '{{term|ظروف}}' constructions.

blocks.caption: تركيب: رَأَيْتُ الهِرَّةَ عَلى الشَّجَرَةِ (12a) و رَأَيْتُ الهِلَالَ بَيْنَ السَّحَابِ (12b)، مع ثَابِتَةً / ثَابِتًا مقدّرا متعلَّقا
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb trees for 12a and 12b, with the implied ثَابِتَةً / ثَابِتًا written small as the muta'allaq

blocks.en: I saw the cat whilst it was on the tree.
I saw the new moon whilst it was between the clouds.

The 'جار مجرور' and 'ظروف' are '{{ruling|متعلق}}' to '{{ruling|ثابت}}' which {{ruling|correlates to the 'ذو الحال' in number & gender}}. In 12a, 'ثَابِتَةً' is in the feminine form due to 'الهِرَّةَ' being feminine and it's '{{ruling|منصوب}}' because of being 'الحال'. In 12b, 'ثَابِتًا' is in the masculine form due to 'الهِلَالَ' being masculine and it's 'منصوب' because of being 'الحال'.
Al-haal: jumlah fi'liyyah

The 'جملة فعلية' will either begin with a 'ماضي' verb or a 'مضارع' verb. If it begins with a {{condition|'ماضي' verb}}, then a '{{ruling|قَدْ}}', for '{{term|تقريب}}', will be brought before the 'ماضي' verb to express close proximity. Examples of a 'جملة فعلية' 'الحال' beginning with the 'ماضي' verb.

blocks.caption: تركيب: يُصَلِّيْ زَيْدٌ قَدْ تَوَضَّأَ (13a) و أَكَل زَيْدٌ وَ قَدْ وَصَلَ بَكرٌ (13b)
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb trees for 13a and 13b, with the hidden فاعل هو drawn under تَوَضَّأَ

blocks.en: Zaid is praying whilst he had just done wudhu.

labels.label: جملة فعلية خبرية - جملة حالية = حال

blocks.ar: أَكَل زَيْدٌ وَ قَدْ وَصَلَ بَكرٌ
blocks.en: Zaid had eaten whilst Bakr had just arrived.

labels.label: جملة فعلية خبرية - جملة حالية = حال

labels.word: أَكَل زَيْدٌ وَ قَدْ وَصَلَ بَكرٌ
labels.label: جملة فعلية خبرية

blocks.en: In 13a, 'قَدْ تَوَضَّأَ' is 'الحال'. The 'قَدْ' is expressing {{ruling|proximity}}, suggesting an almost synchronous event. In 13b, 'وَقَدْ وَصَلَ بَكرٌ' is 'الحال'. A 'وَ' is added here known as '{{term|الواو الحالية}}' which will be discussed later.
Al-haal: jumlah fi'liyyah

If the 'جملة فعلية' begins with a {{condition|'مضارع' verb}}, then a 'قَدْ', for 'تقريب', {{ruling|will not be brought}} because the 'مضارع' verb will sync in time with the primary action. Examples of a 'جملة فعلية' 'الحال' beginning with the 'مضارع' verb.

blocks.caption: تركيب: جَاءَ زَيْدٌ يَرْكَبُ (14a) و تَدْرُسُ فاطِمَةُ وَ قَدْ تَجْهَدُ (14b)
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb trees for 14a and 14b, with the hidden فاعل هو / هي drawn under the verb

blocks.en: Zaid came whilst riding.

labels.label: جملة فعلية خبرية - جملة حالية = حال

blocks.en: Fatimah studies whilst certainly working hard

labels.label: جملة فعلية خبرية - جملة حالية = حال

blocks.en: In 14a, 'يَرْكَبُ' is 'الحال'. It is translated as 'رَاكِبًا' and it's able to replace 'يَرْكَبُ'. In 14b, 'وَقَدْ تَجْهَدُ' is 'الحال'. The 'قد' is added for {{ruling|emphasis, not for proximity}}.
Al-haal: jumlah ismiyyah
The 'جملة اسمية' will be {{ruling|any type of a 'جملة اسمية'}}. Whether constructed with a '{{term|مبتدا خبر}}' or '{{term|اسم خبر}}'.

blocks.caption: تركيب: قَامَ زَيْدٌ رِجْلُهُ مَكْسُوْرٌ (15a) و جَاءَ زَيْدٌ وَ الشَّمْسُ طَالَعَةٌ (15b)
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb trees for 15a and 15b

blocks.en: Zaid stood whilst his leg was broken.

labels.label: جملة اسمية خبرية - جملة حالية = حال

blocks.en: Zaid came whilst the sun was rising.

labels.label: جملة اسمية خبرية - جملة حالية = حال

blocks.en: In 14a, ' رِجْلُهُ مَكْسُوْرٌ' is 'الحال'. There is {{ruling|a pronoun 'ه'}} in reference to the 'ذو الحال'. In 14b, 'وَالشَّمْسُ طَالَعَةٌ' is 'الحال'. There is {{ruling|no pronoun}} in reference to the 'ذو الحال'.
Al-haal: al-waw al-haaliyah
When a 'جملة' is made 'الحال', the 'جملة' is called a '{{term|جملة حالية}}' to signify the purpose and role of the sentence. This does not signify the essence (being اسمية، فعلية) of the sentence.
A 'جملة حالية' {{ruling|requires the presence of a 'رابط' (connector)}} inside of it. This 'رابط' will enable the 'جملة حالية' to remain connected with the primary sentence.

If {{condition|the 'رابط' is not present}} in the 'جملة حالية', it will disconnect and become an independent sentence without any connection to the primary sentence and {{ruling|will NOT express the meaning of 'حال'}}.
A '{{term|ضمير}}', present in the 'جملة حالية', which {{condition|correlates to the 'ذو الحال' in N/G}} will serve as a 'رابط' in this topic.

Sometimes, the 'رابط' is necessary and can not be omitted whilst at other times, it is permissible for the 'رابط' to be omitted. In such scenarios where {{condition|the 'رابط' is omitted from the 'جملة حالية'}}, the '{{ruling|الواو الحالية}}' will substitute the 'رابط'. Therefore, either a 'رابط' will be present in the 'جملة حالية' or 'الواو الحالية' will be present.
However, sometimes {{ruling|both}}, the 'رابط' and the 'الواو الحالية' can be present.
Therefore, it is important to delve further into this matter and acquire additional knowledge to prevent mistakes in our expressions and sentence analysis.
Al-haal: al-waw al-haaliyah
Below are the places where the 'الواو الحالية' {{ruling|MUST be present}}. Whether the 'الواو الحالية' is substituting the 'رابط' or not, it must be present.

blocks.en: Time Synchronisation
Taking time synchronisation into consideration, the general principle of 'الحال' is to {{ruling|synchronise in time with the primary action}} mentioned the sentence.

When the 'الحال' is a 'اسم' ('مشتق', 'مصدر', 'جامد'), a 'شبه الجملة', a 'جملة فعلية' (with a 'مضارع' verb) or a 'جملة اسمية', then, {{condition|in the absence of an external factor indicating future tense}}, the 'الحال' will {{ruling|synchronise in time with the primary action}}.
This is because, all of the above can be used to express the {{ruling|present tense}}.
When using a 'الحال' which signifies the present tense, it will signify {{ruling|the present tense of the primary action}}.

If {{condition|the primary action is in the past tense and the 'الحال' is a 'مضارع' verb}} for instance, then the 'مضارع' verb will express {{ruling|the present tense of the past tense of the primary action}}.
Lets look at a few examples to understand this better.
Time Synchronisation: Examples
I recited the Qur'an whilst in the state of wudhu
I am reciting/will recite the Qur'an whilst in the state of wudhu.
Zaid ate whilst in the state of being at home
Zaid is eating/will eat whilst in the state of being at home
Bakr travelled whilst he was standing
Bakr is travelling/will travel whilst he is/will be standing
I came whilst the sun was rising
I am coming/will come whilst the sun is/will be rising

{{condition|If the 'الحال' is in the past tense}}, then the past tense 'الحال' will signify upon {{ruling|the past tense of the primary action}} whether that action is in the past, present or future tense.
Bakr travelled whilst he had just eaten.
Bakr is/will travel whilst he has/will just have eaten

blocks.caption: يُسَافر بَكْرٌ: يَأْكُلُ / قَدْ أَكَلَ
blocks.caption_en: Timeline under يُسَافر بَكْرٌ with three bands: Future Tense of the Action (empty), Action Tense (يَأْكُلُ, whilst eating.), Past Tense of the Action (أَكَلَ crossed ✘, قَدْ ticked ✓: whilst he had just eaten.)

blocks.en: It is {{ruling|necessary}} that a 'قَدْ', for '{{term|تقريب}}', is brought before the 'ماضي' verb to express close proximity, to make it close as possible to the 'Action Tense' in an attempt to almost make it sync. Although total synchronisation has not been achieved, it has come close enough for the ruling of 'الحال' to be applicable.
If, {{condition|due to an external factor, the 'الحال' is understood to be in the future tense}}, then such a 'الحال' is known as a '{{term|الحال المُقَدَّرَة}}' a decreed or circumstantial 'الحال'.
Bakr is traveling whilst he is destined to reach Makkah tomorrow.
Zaid is studying whilst destined to be an Alim

In such scenarios, the 'الحال' is in the meaning of '{{term|مُقَدَّرًا}}', 'being destined'. The 'الحال', 'مُقَدَّرًا' is understood to be {{ruling|in sync with the 'Action tense'}}, This means the 'ذو الحال', in its current state, is in the state of 'being destined' with something. So, in S6a, Bakr's current state is that 'He is destined' to reach Makkah tomorrow. And in S6b, Zaid's current state is that 'He is destined' to becoming an Alim.
So, if we look at S6a with the 'الحال المُقَدَّرَة' and other possible tenses the sentence would be as follows: 'Bakr is traveling…'

blocks.caption: يُسَافر بَكْرٌ: مُقَدَّرًا بِأن يَصِلَ مَكَّةَ غَدًا / يَأْكُلُ / قَدْ أَكَلَ
blocks.caption_en: Timeline under يُسَافر بَكْرٌ: Future Tense of the Action (مُقَدَّرًا بِأن يَصِلَ مَكَّةَ غَدًا, whilst he is to reach Makkah tomorrow.), Action Tense greyed (يَأْكُلُ, whilst eating.), Past Tense of the Action greyed (قَدْ أَكَلَ, whilst he had just eaten.)

blocks.ar: {{example|يُسَافر بَكْرٌ مُقَدَّرًا بِأن يَصِلَ مَكَّةَ غَدًا}}
blocks.en: Bakr is traveling… whilst he is to reach Makkah tomorrow.
The actual 'الحال' is assumed to be 'مُقَدَّرًا', an '{{term|اسم المفعول}}' which is {{ruling|in sync with the 'Action tense'}}, and will also {{ruling|correlate with the 'ذو الحال' in N/G}}.

blocks.ar: {{example|يُدۡخِلُهُمۡ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِى مِن تَحۡتِهَا الۡأَنۡهٰرُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا}} (المجادلة ٢٢)
blocks.en: He will enter them into gardens beneath which rivers flow whilst they will reside therein forever (Al-Mujadalah 22)
So, if we look at S6b with the 'الحال المُقَدَّرَة' and other possible tenses the sentence would be as follows: 'Bakr is traveling…'

blocks.caption: يُسَافر بَكْرٌ: مُقَدَّرًا بِأن يَصِلَ مَكَّةَ غَدًا / يَأْكُلُ / قَدْ أَكَلَ
blocks.caption_en: The same timeline as the previous page, repeated as printed: Future Tense of the Action (مُقَدَّرًا بِأن يَصِلَ مَكَّةَ غَدًا, whilst he is to reach Makkah tomorrow.), Action Tense greyed (يَأْكُلُ, whilst eating.), Past Tense of the Action greyed (قَدْ أَكَلَ, whilst he had just eaten.)

blocks.en: The actual 'الحال' is assumed to be 'مُقَدَّرًا', an '{{term|اسم المفعول}}' which is in sync with the 'Action tense', and will also {{ruling|correlate with the 'ذو الحال' in N/G}}.

blocks.ar: {{example|يُدۡخِلُهُمۡ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِى مِن تَحۡتِهَا الۡأَنۡهٰرُ مُقَدَّرِيْنَ بِالْخُلُوْدِ فِيهَا}}
blocks.en: He will enter them into gardens beneath which rivers flow whilst they are destined with everlasting residence therein.
Sequence

In regards to the sequence of the 'الحال', it is {{ruling|permissible}} for the 'الحال' to {{ruling|precede the 'ذو الحال'}}. It is also permissible for the 'الحال' to {{ruling|precede its governor}}, the primary action verb.

blocks.caption: تركيب: جَاءَ رَاكبًا زَيْدٌ / رَاكِبًا جَاءَ زَيْدٌ
blocks.caption_en: Two tarkeeb trees, 16a and 16b, each labelled word by word (فعل, حال, ذو الحال). In 16a a line joins حال and ذو الحال and is labelled فاعل; in 16b one line runs under all three words with فاعل beneath it and a tick dropping from فعل. In both the whole is labelled جملة فعلية خبرية.

blocks.en: Zaid came whilst riding.
Zaid came whilst riding.
In 16a, 'رَاكِبًا' is 'الحال' and it has {{ruling|preceded the 'ذو الحال'}}. In 16b, 'رَاكِبًا' is 'الحال' and it has {{ruling|preceded the 'ذو الحال' and its governor 'جَاءَ'}}.
Sequence

However, if the ‘{{term|ذو الحال}}’ is ‘{{condition|نكرة منصوبة}}’, then it is {{ruling|wajib}} for the ‘الحال’ to {{ruling|precede}} the ‘ذو الحال’. This is so the ‘الحال’ is not mistaken as a ‘{{term|صفة/نعت}}’.

blocks.caption: تركيبان جنبا إلى جنب: ١٧أ «رَأَيْتُ رَاكِبًا رَجُلًا» و١٧ب «رَأَيْتُ رَجُلًا رَاكِبًا»، تحت كل كلمة إعرابها، وتحت الكلمتين الأخيرتين خط وتحته «مفعول به»، وتحت الجميع خط وتحته «جملة فعلية خبرية»
blocks.caption_en: Two tarkeeb diagrams side by side: 17a «رَأَيْتُ رَاكِبًا رَجُلًا» and 17b «رَأَيْتُ رَجُلًا رَاكِبًا». Each word has its label under it, the last two words are underlined and called مفعول به, and the whole is underlined and called جملة فعلية خبرية.

blocks.en: 17a. I saw a man whilst (he was) riding.
17b. I saw a riding man.

In 17a, ‘رَاكِبًا’ is ‘{{label|الحال}}’ and it has {{ruling|preceded}} the ‘ذو الحال’. In 17b, ‘رَاكِبًا’ is ‘{{label|صفة}}’ as it has come after ‘رَجُلًا’ the ‘موصوف’ and since ‘رَجُلًا’ is ‘منصوب’ and ‘رَاكِبًا’ has come after, they will be considered ‘موصوف’ and ‘صفة’ instead of ‘ذو الحال’ and ‘الحال’ due to the rule based on the importance of the sequence mentioned above.
مضاف إليه ذو الحال

When the ‘ذو الحال’ is ‘{{condition|مضاف إليه}}’, then, according to the majority of the grammarians, it is necessary: 1. For the ‘مضاف’ to be a ‘{{ruling|شبه الفعل}}’. The meaning will resemble that of a ‘فعل فاعل’ or ‘فعل مفعول ’.

blocks.caption: تركيبان جنبا إلى جنب: ١٨أ «هذَا نَاصِرُ فَاطِمَةَ مُحْتَاجَةً» و١٨ب «رَأَيْتُ سُقُوْطَ زَيْدٍ غَافِلًا»، تحت كل كلمة إعرابها، وخطوط متداخلة تجمع «مضاف إليه» ثم «خبر» أو «مفعول به» ثم الجملة كلها
blocks.caption_en: Two tarkeeb diagrams side by side: 18a «هذَا نَاصِرُ فَاطِمَةَ مُحْتَاجَةً» and 18b «رَأَيْتُ سُقُوْطَ زَيْدٍ غَافِلًا». Each word has its label under it, with nested underlines grouping the مضاف إليه, then the خبر or مفعول به, then the whole sentence.

blocks.en: 18a. This is Fatimah’s helper whilst she is in need.
18b. I saw Zaid’s fall whilst he was unaware.

In 18a, ‘مُحْتَاجَةً’ is ‘{{label|الحال}}’ and ‘فَاطِمَةَ’ is the ‘{{label|ذو الحال}}’ which is the ‘مضاف إليه’ and the ‘مضاف’ ‘ناصر’ is a ‘{{ruling|شبه الفعل}}’. In meaning ‘فَاطِمَةَ’ is the ‘{{label|مفعول}}’ because she is receiving the action of help, she was helped. In 18b, ‘غافِلًا’ is ‘الحال’ and ‘زيد’ is the ‘ذو الحال’ which is the ‘مضاف إليه’ and the ‘مضاف’ ‘سقوط’ is a ‘شبه الفعل’. In meaning ‘زيد’ is the ‘{{label|فاعل}}’ because he is doing the action of falling, he fell.
مضاف إليه ذو الحال
…or it is necessary: 2. For the ‘مضاف’ to be a {{ruling|physical part}} of the ‘مضاف إليه’ .

blocks.caption: تركيبان جنبا إلى جنب: ١٩أ «يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيه مَيْتًا» و١٩ب «رَأَيْتُ رَأْسَ زَيْدٍ جَالِسًا»، تحت كل كلمة إعرابها، وفي ١٩أ قوس أحمر من الفعل إلى «هو» المكتوب صغيرا علامةً على الفاعل المستتر، وتحت «أَخِيه» صغيرا «مضافَ مضافَ إليه»
blocks.caption_en: Two tarkeeb diagrams side by side: 19a «يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيه مَيْتًا» and 19b «رَأَيْتُ رَأْسَ زَيْدٍ جَالِسًا». Each word has its label under it. In 19a a red arc runs from the verb to a small هو marking the hidden فاعل, and أَخِيه has a small مضافَ مضافَ إليه written under it.

blocks.en: 19a. He eats his brother’s meat whilst he is dead.
19b. I saw Zaid’s head whilst he was sitting.

In 19a, ‘ميتًا’ is ‘{{label|الحال}}’ and ‘أخيهَ’ is the ‘{{label|ذو الحال}}’ which is the ‘مضاف إليه’ and the ‘مضاف’, ‘لحم’ is a {{ruling|physical part}} of ‘ميتًا’. In 19b, ‘جالسًا’ is ‘الحال’ and ‘زيد’ is the ‘ذو الحال’ which is the ‘مضاف إليه’ and the ‘مضاف’, ‘رَأْسَ’ is a physical part of ‘زيد’.
مضاف إليه ذو الحال

…or it is necessary: 3. For the ‘مضاف’ to be {{ruling|omittable}} in the sense that the ‘مضاف إليه’ should be able to {{condition|suffice without the ‘مضاف’}}. Doing this should not corrupt the meaning of the sentence/expression.

blocks.caption: تركيبان جنبا إلى جنب: ٢٠أ «اِتَّبعْ مِلَّةَ إبْرَاهِيْمَ حَنِيْفًا» و٢٠ب «رَأَيْتُ نَحْوَ زَيْدٍ مُنَادِيًا»، تحت كل كلمة إعرابها، وفي ٢٠أ قوس أحمر من الفعل إلى «أنتَ» المكتوب صغيرا علامةً على الفاعل المستتر
blocks.caption_en: Two tarkeeb diagrams side by side: 20a «اِتَّبعْ مِلَّةَ إبْرَاهِيْمَ حَنِيْفًا» and 20b «رَأَيْتُ نَحْوَ زَيْدٍ مُنَادِيًا». Each word has its label under it. In 20a a red arc runs from the verb to a small أنتَ marking the hidden فاعل.

blocks.en: 20a. Follow the way of Ibrahim who is in the state of being upright.
20b. I looked towards Zaid whilst he was calling.

In 20a, ‘حَنِيْفًا’ is ‘{{label|الحال}}’ and ‘إبراهيم’ is the ‘{{label|ذو الحال}}’ which is the ‘مضاف إليه’ and the ‘مضاف’, ‘ملة’ is {{ruling|omittable}}. ‘إبْرَاهِيْمَ’ will suffice in retaining the over all meaning: Follow Ibrahim who is in the state of being upright. In 20b, ‘مُنَادِيًا’ is ‘الحال’ and ‘زَيْدٍ’ is the ‘ذو الحال’ which is the ‘مضاف إليه’ and the ‘مضاف’, ‘نَحْوَ’ is omittable. ‘زَيْدٍ’ will suffice in retaining the over all meaning. I saw Zaid whilst he was calling.
Multiple ZH-H
There can be a {{ruling|multiple number}} of ‘ذو الحال’ and ‘الحال’. There can be {{condition|1 x ‘ذو الحال’ and many ‘الحال’}} or {{condition|many ‘ذو الحال’ and 1 x ‘الحال’}}.

blocks.caption: تركيبان جنبا إلى جنب: ٢١أ «جاء زيدٌ راكبًا آكِلًا» و٢١ب «رَأَيْتُ زَيْدًا رَاكِبَيْنِ»، تحت كل كلمة إعرابها، وفي ٢١أ تحت المجموعة خط وتحته «فاعل»، وفي ٢١ب تحت الحال وذي الحالين خط وتحته «مفعول به» و«فاعل» جنبا إلى جنب، وتحت الجميع «جملة فعلية خبرية»
blocks.caption_en: Two tarkeeb diagrams side by side: 21a «جاء زيدٌ راكبًا آكِلًا» and 21b «رَأَيْتُ زَيْدًا رَاكِبَيْنِ». Each word has its label under it, in 21a the group is underlined and called فاعل; in 21b the حال and both ذو الحال are underlined, with مفعول به and فاعل written side by side under that line (فاعل under the تُ side); and the whole is called جملة فعلية خبرية.

blocks.en: 21a. Zaid came whilst riding & eating.
21b. I saw Zaid whilst we both were riding.

In 21a, ‘راكبًا’ and ‘آكِلًا’ are ‘{{label|الحال}}’ and ‘زيدٌ’ is the ‘{{label|ذو الحال}}’. We have a multiple number of ‘الحال’ and 1 ‘ذو الحال’. In 21b, ‘رَاكِبَيْنِ’ is ‘الحال’ and ‘تُ’ and ‘زَيْدًا’ are ‘ذو الحال’. Here, we have a multiple number of ‘ذو الحال’ and 1 ‘الحال’.
Multiple ZH-H

Or there can be {{condition|many ‘ذو الحال’ and many ‘الحال’}}. Here, we must bring the ‘الحال’ for the {{ruling|latter}} ‘ذو الحال’ {{ruling|first}} and the ‘الحال’ for the {{ruling|former}} ‘ذو الحال’ {{ruling|delayed}}.

blocks.caption: تركيبان جنبا إلى جنب: ٢٢أ «لَقِيْتُ زَيْدًا جَالِسًا قَائِمًا» و٢٢ب «نَصَرْتُ زَيْنَبَ جَالِسَةً قَائِمًا»، تحت كل كلمة إعرابها، وتحت ذي الحال الثاني وحاله خط وتحته «مفعول به»، وخط منقط يجمع ضمير المتكلم مع الحال الأخيرة وتحته «فاعل»، وتحت الجميع «جملة فعلية خبرية»
blocks.caption_en: Two tarkeeb diagrams side by side: 22a «لَقِيْتُ زَيْدًا جَالِسًا قَائِمًا» and 22b «نَصَرْتُ زَيْنَبَ جَالِسَةً قَائِمًا». Each word has its label under it; the second ذو الحال and its حال are underlined as مفعول به, a dotted line joins the speaker's pronoun with the last حال as فاعل, and the whole is called جملة فعلية خبرية.

blocks.en: 22a. I met Zaid whilst he was sitting and I was standing.
22b. I helped Zainab whilst she was sitting and I was standing

In 22a, ‘جَالِسًا’ and ‘قَائِمًا’ are ‘{{label|الحال}}’, and ‘تُ’ and ‘زيدًا’ are ‘{{label|ذو الحال}}’. ‘جَالِسًا’ is the ‘الحال’ of ‘زيدًا’, the {{ruling|latter}} ‘ذو الحال’ while ‘قَائِمًا’ is the ‘الحال’ of ‘تُ’, the {{ruling|former}} ‘ذو الحال’. In 22b, ‘جَالِسَةً’ and ‘قَائِمًا’ are ‘الحال’ and ‘تُ’ and ‘زَيْنَبَ’ are ‘ذو الحال’. ‘جَالِسَةً’ is the ‘الحال’ of ‘زَيْنَبَ’, the latter ‘ذو الحال’ while ‘قَائِمًا’ is the ‘الحال’ of ‘تُ’ the former ‘ذو الحال’.
Conclusion
Conclusion: Further details regarding ‘حال’ such as {{term|omitting the governor}} etc will be discussed at another point in time insha’Allah.
The {{term|Circumstantial Clause}}
